subject.title: [Bug]: BUSY_ACTIVITY_STALE_THRESHOLD_MS hardcoded at 25min with no config surface — health monitor restarts channel mid-turn

question: Should channel health treat continuous active-turn progress as sufficient to suppress the fixed stuck timeout, or should OpenClaw add a supported gateway setting that lets operators choose the busy-run recovery window?
rationale: The core health monitor balances two valid but opposing outcomes: avoiding interruption of legitimate long turns and recovering channel accounts whose active run is genuinely wedged. Repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration/default surfaces, so code inspection alone cannot choose the permanent operator contract.

options.title: Fix progress accounting without a new setting
options.body: Keep one canonical stuck-recovery policy but ensure real tool and turn progress refreshes the activity signal so healthy long-running work is not restarted.

options.title: Add a bounded busy-run policy setting
options.body: Expose a documented gateway threshold only if operators demonstrably need different recovery windows and maintainers accept the compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Fix progress accounting without a new setting
recommendation.body: Keep one canonical stuck-recovery policy but ensure real tool and turn progress refreshes the activity signal so healthy long-running work is not restarted.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the active-run and channel-health decision surface that the issue asks to change.
